text:
emily: quick q — we need to standardize error wording for auth failures in SDK snippets. currently some say 'Invalid token' and others 'Authentication failed'. prefer one?

sam: I'd vote for 'Authentication failed' — clearer to users. Should we include suggestion to add code example with try/catch?

jorge: +1 for consistent phrase. also flag param names: api_key vs apiKey vs API_KEY — SDKs should use camelCase, docs show snake_case in some places.

emily: agreed. proposal: docs style: use camelCase for SDK params, UPPER_SNAKE for env vars. update glossary entry: 'api key' canonical form 'API key'?

nina: suggestion: in microcopy avoid 'token' unless referring to JWT. use 'API key' for static keys. Add regex snippet to validate.

sam: adding snippet:

```js
if (!process.env.API_KEY) throw new Error('Authentication failed: missing API key')
```

emily: thanks — this looks good. I'll prefer minimal in-line code; we should include the snippet in the SDK snippets repo instead of duplicating.

doc-bot: Note: created issue #542 in docs repo for auth microcopy normalization — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/542 :spiral_note_pad:

emily: thanks. I'll queue a PR with a find/replace and small migration guide for SDK maintainers. target for EOW?

sam: EOW works. I'll audit sdk snippets in node/python.

jorge: will update glossary definition for 'API key' and 'token'. assign to emily+jorge.

nina: also update translator note for localization: keep 'Authentication failed' unchanged.

emily: perfect — I'll file the PR and ping this thread when ready :white_check_mark:
